description: This file defines the ShippingMethod controller class for handling shipping methods in the checkout process of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying available shipping options, validating and saving shipping choices, and managing session data related to shipping.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class managing shipping options during checkout, extending the base \Opencart\System\Engine\Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the current selected shipping method and related data to the view.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Provides available shipping methods based on cart and session validation, returning data in JSON format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method to session data after validation and responds with success or error in JSON.
